subject: Acme Retail: evaluation data & prompt pack transfer plan

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Retail: evaluation data & prompt pack transfer plan
message_1_body:
Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is the mutual action plan (MAP) draft and the initial prompt pack we discussed. I’ve highlighted the minimum test-case surface we recommend for the 2-week evaluation window and the milestone dates we think are needed to make a go/no-go decision.

Key asks from Redwood to Acme for exchange:
- Confirm the list of use-case test-cases (we included 18 sample prompts).
- Sign the evaluation dataset terms sheet (short license + usage constraints; see row 4 of the MAP).
- Provide a security contact for the SOC2 questionnaire items.

Deliverables attached: prompt pack (prompt examples + expected output forms) and MAP timeline (workback schedule). We can provide a 1,000-row sample extract of your anonymized data for model probing once the dataset terms are signed.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Aug 25: Share MAP + prompt pack (this email).
- Aug 26–27: Acme confirms test cases and returns signed dataset terms.
- Aug 30: Redwood uploads sample dataset and configures sandbox.
- Sep 1–12: Evaluation run (2 weeks).
- Sep 15: Decision and next-step call.

Please let me know if you want changes to the MAP or if your legal team needs a different doc format. I’ve CC’d Marissa (solutions) so we have alignment on onboarding.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: ACM_MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (zip)
message_2_headers:

message_2_body:
Thanks, Karthik — this looks good and concise. A few quick items before we can accept the sample dataset: 

1) Legal needs the dataset usage constraints spelled out in one page (retention, derivative works, deletion after 90 days). Can you provide a short addendum?
2) Security wants to run through the SOC2 questionnaire; can Marissa or someone from solutions own that?
3) We’d like to pare the test-case list down to ~10 canonical prompts for the MVP evaluation; I’ll pull our product PMs together and send back a shortlist by EOD Aug 27.

If you can send the one-page dataset terms addendum and point Marissa at the security POC, we’ll aim to sign and upload the required PA/LOU by Friday.

—Emma
Emma Lloyd
Head of Product, Acme Retail
emma.lloyd@acmeretail.com

message_3_headers:

Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Retail: evaluation data & prompt pack transfer plan
message_3_body:
Hi Emma — Marissa here from Solutions. Happy to own the SOC2 Q&A and we'll coordinate with your security POC.

Attached is a 100-row preview CSV (anonymized) that demonstrates the format we use when ingesting sample exports; this is purely illustrative and made from synthetic data. For the one-page dataset terms addendum, see key bullets below (I’ve also attached a short CSV and a permissive addendum draft to accelerate legal):

- Retention: Redwood will store the evaluation dataset for 90 days from ingestion; a deletion request will be honored within 5 business days.
- Derivatives: Redwood may derive aggregated evaluation artifacts (metrics, non-identifiable logs) but will not surface customer data in other accounts; no commercial use beyond the evaluation without an explicit license.
- Access: Only the Acme-designated contacts plus Redwood engineers working on the sandbox will have access.
- Audit: We will enable audit logging for model calls tied to the trial; logs retained 30 days by default.

Next steps:
- Aug 27 EOD: Emma sends trimmed list of ~10 prompts.
- Aug 30: Assuming terms accepted, we’ll ingest sample and open sandbox.

If Acme legal wants the addendum attached in DocuSign-ready format, let me know and Rishi from Legal can produce a redline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: acme_sample_dataset_preview.csv (csv), prompt-addendum-draft.txt (text)

Hi Emma / Acme Legal — Rishi from Redwood Legal here. I attached a redline to the addendum with two small clarifications we need:

1) Confirm permitted derivative artifacts cannot be used to train models for commercial products without an explicit written license.
2) Add a 30-day notice for data deletion automation to account for backups — practical retention windows.

These are intended to be minimal and to unblock the sample transfer. If those points are okay, I can prepare a DocuSign-ready final.

Quoting Marissa’s note below for context:
> - Retention: Redwood will store the evaluation dataset for 90 days from ingestion; a deletion request will be honored within 5 business days.
> - Derivatives: Redwood may derive aggregated evaluation artifacts (metrics, non-identifiable logs) but will not surface customer data in other accounts; no commercial use beyond the evaluation without an explicit license.

Please let me know if your legal team prefers an alternative phrasing — I’ll hold the redline until I hear back.
